summary: Dear Press, please stop referring to the Trump/Zelensky document as a transcript....A transcript is verbatim, this is a cherry picked memo...not a transcript...still damning but semantics matter, don't lend credence to a cover up.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Dear Press, please stop referring to the Trump/Zelensky document as a transcript....A transcript is verbatim, this is a cherry picked memo...not a transcript...still damning but semantics matter, don't lend credence to a cover up.
